title: Bros Attacks
subtitle: Cooperative techniques filed by Waluigi
description: A Bros Attack is a coordinated maneuver in which two allies spend timing, positioning, and trust to produce an effect neither could reliably make alone. The archive currently contains two confirmed techniques.

clearing.name: Clearing
clearing.summary: One partner creates height or leverage so the other can cut, break or force a way through.
clearing.doctrine: The lifter owns the footing, the cutter owns the arc, and neither counts out loud.
clearing.sourceNote: Named for the Feyward corridor cut, where a countdown nearly caused friendly fire and a shared rhythm succeeded.

support_fire.name: Support Fire
support_fire.summary: One partner controls the sightline and the timing; the other delivers the shot and resets.
support_fire.doctrine: The caller is responsible for the miss. The shooter is responsible for the reset.
support_fire.sourceNote: Named for the manoeuvre Green T taught Remi from a printed sheet and used against a barricaded door.

lift_carry.name: Lift and Carry
lift_carry.summary: Moving a person or a heavy object that one character cannot move alone — under fire, or under protest.
lift_carry.doctrine: Decide who is carrying before you pick anything up. Arguing mid-lift is how people get dropped.
lift_carry.sourceNote: Recorded three times: Toadsworth and Thornpaw lifting the frozen Luigi block, Markop's firefighter carry of Remi, and Lanky taking Koffin-K around the middle with Bulky piling in behind.

shieldwork.name: Shieldwork
shieldwork.summary: One partner holds a line or absorbs an attack so the other can act without being interrupted.
shieldwork.doctrine: Hold the rim, brace the wrist, and shove — a shield that only blocks is half a shield.
shieldwork.sourceNote: Named for Remi holding the cottage line during the imp ambush, shield rim biting her wrist while she shoved the invisible attacker back.

misdirection.name: Misdirection
misdirection.summary: One partner manufactures a distraction so the other can move, strike or slip past unobserved.
misdirection.doctrine: The distraction has to cost something to be believed.
misdirection.sourceNote: Named for the Platform Four bypass — combined steam distraction and a theatrical toe-injury covering a manual flux purge.

attacks.name: Support Fire Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Green T and Remi's barricaded-door technique
attacks.description: One partner steadies the shooter's aim, adjusts her position, and calls the timing so the shot lands with greater force and accuracy. Green T taught Remi the maneuver from a simple instruction sheet. Remi immediately used it against the tanuki behind a barricaded bathroom door, making the technique effective and the circumstances disastrous.
steps: Choose the shooter and the partner providing the brace or timing call.
The support partner corrects stance, sightline, and target timing.
The shooter waits for the call rather than firing on impulse.
Resolve the shot with improved coordination, then account for the moral and tactical consequences.
attacks.risks: The technique improves a bad decision as efficiently as a good one. A clearer shot does not make the target lawful, safe, or deserving of being shot.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Green T managed to turn mentorship into a firearms incident before the ink on the instructional sheet dried. That is not a failure of coordination. That is coordination working for the wrong sentence.

drill.promptDescription: Green T lines up the shot and calls the moment. Remi fires, then resets safely.

steps.title: Steady the aim
steps.instruction: Hold Space (or hold the button). Release the instant the charge meter is in the green zone.

steps.title: Call the timing
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press → (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Fire
steps.instruction: Wait for GO, then press Enter (or click) immediately. Too early or too late misses.

steps.title: Reset safely
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↓ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

variations.name: Tanuki Liberation Bros Attack
variations.account: Remi took the initiative to use a Bros Attack technique taught by Green T, adjusting her aim downward before firing through the barricaded bathroom door. This action freed The Tanuki from the dangerous situation.

attacks.name: Chop Bros
attacks.subtitle: Hjumpik and Toad Lee's twenty-five-foot corridor cut
attacks.description: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee to vine-height while Toad Lee chops through the growth ahead. The first attempt failed because Toad Lee was too heavy. The second nearly produced friendly fire after a countdown. The third worked when they stopped counting and found a shared rhythm, opening twenty-five feet of corridor and pushing the leaves back.
steps: Hjumpik establishes a stable lift and carries Toad Lee into cutting range.
Toad Lee keeps the axe clear of Hjumpik and the Guard.
Both partners move by rhythm rather than a shouted countdown.
Advance through the opened growth and stop before exhaustion turns the lift into a drop.
attacks.risks: The lift is heavy, the axe has a wide arc, and a countdown can make the swing arrive before the body is ready. The technique requires trust and room to fail safely.
attacks.result: Verified success: twenty-five feet of corridor opened; a large amount of leaf growth pushed back; the party reached the window and climbed upward at the end of the engagement.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Attempt One failed on weight. Attempt Two failed on numbers. Attempt Three succeeded when the bros stopped performing the maneuver and started listening to each other. I hate how instructive this is.

drill.promptDescription: Hjumpik lifts Toad Lee. Toad Lee chops the growth. The pair advances through the opening.

steps.title: Lift Toad Lee
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↑ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Chop down
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press ↓ (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

steps.title: Chop down again
steps.instruction: One more — press ↓ (or click) when the marker hits the green zone.

steps.title: Advance
steps.instruction: Watch the bar. Press → (or click) the instant the marker is in the green zone.

attacks.name: Goblin Alchemy Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Markop creates height, Archie slices through the blood manor's defenses.
attacks.description: Markop uses his alchemy skills to create a height advantage, allowing Archie Miser to launch an air attack and slice through the defenses of the blood manor.
steps: Markop taps up to create a vial of Blazefizz Gloomvials.
Archie aims at the weak point in the wall with his fire magic.
Blazefizz Gloomvials ignite, giving Archie an opportunity to strike.
Archie Miser cuts through the defenses with his mage's blade.
attacks.risks: If Markop fails to create a stable height advantage, Archie could be exposed or injured during the attack.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! Yet another reckless move that nearly got them all killed. Markop, you're a walking alchemy kit. Archie, you’re still alive... for now.

drill.promptDescription: Create height and leverage to allow your partner to strike an enemy weak point.

steps.title: Tap Up
steps.instruction: Use an alchemical vial to create a stable height advantage.

steps.title: Aim
steps.instruction: Target the weak point with your magical attack.

steps.title: Stabilize
steps.instruction: Maintain height and leverage until your partner's attack connects.

steps.title: Strike
steps.instruction: Execute the final blow on the weak point.

attacks.name: Astral Portal Creation Bros Attack
attacks.subtitle: Archie Miser and The Oracle perform the ritual without a circle.
attacks.description: Archie Miser absorbs dangerous amounts of mana to create a portal, while The Oracle channels energy and focuses the ritual. Together they manage to open an Astral Altar, enabling Archie to travel to the Shadowfell.
steps: Archie Miser: Tap the center of the circle.
The Oracle: Point at the candles to focus energy.
Archie Miser: Gather mana by rising your hand.
The Oracle: Channel energy to create the portal.
attacks.risks: If either partner fails their roll, the portal may collapse or malfunction, endangering all participants.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! To think, two mages of this caliber could pull off a ritual without a circle. What will they do next? Sacrifice a village?

drill.promptDescription: Simulate the creation of the Astral Portal with precise gestures.

steps.title: Center Yourself
steps.instruction: Tap the center of the circle.

steps.title: Align the Candles
steps.instruction: Point at the candles to focus energy.

steps.title: Absorb Mana
steps.instruction: Gather mana by rising your hand.

steps.title: Direct Energy
steps.instruction: Channel energy to create the portal.

attacks.name: Held Line
attacks.subtitle: One partner holds a barrier in place while the other works behind it
attacks.description: One partner puts something solid between the group and what is coming — a shield, a body, a wall of ice — and holds it there while the other does the work that actually solves the problem. It only looks like the defensive partner is the passive one. They are the one deciding how much time the other gets, and they are usually the one who runs out of it first. Waluigi froze back the overgrowth while Hjumpik cleared the manor. Michael Afton stood between Wario and the animatronics long enough for a conversation to finish. Stone braced against Baldi's ruler while Miller cut at it.
steps: The holding partner says plainly how long they can hold, and does not round up.
The working partner starts only once the barrier is actually set, not while it is going up.
The holding partner calls the time remaining out loud as it runs down.
Both partners break together on the call, whether or not the work is finished.
attacks.risks: The barrier fails all at once, not gradually, and it usually fails while the working partner still has their hands full. Whoever holds the line cannot retreat without deciding for both of them that the job is over — which makes it very hard to say the one thing that needs saying: that they cannot hold.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! This is why I'm always so careful. One slip and we're all covered in mushrooms again!

drill.promptDescription: Navigate through a frozen area while maintaining an ice shield.

steps.title: Create Shield
steps.instruction: Create an ice shield and maintain it for three seconds.

steps.title: Clear Path
steps.instruction: Move to the right, clearing a path through frozen plants.

steps.title: Hold Shield
steps.instruction: Maintain the shield while B clears past.

steps.title: Final Clear
steps.instruction: Clear any final obstacles in your path.

variations.name: Shieldwork Bros Attack
variations.account: Michael Afton shields Wario from the animatronics so that he can have a conversation with Cassidy, ensuring his safety and allowing for the resolution of the supernatural crisis.

variations.name: Ruler Counterattack Bros Attack
variations.account: 'Brick' Stone and 'Viper' Miller coordinate their movements to create a defensive line against Baldi's ruler, which grows to four times its normal size. Stone holds the line while Miller strikes with his combat knife.

attacks.name: Split Attention
attacks.subtitle: One partner becomes the most interesting thing in the room so the other can move unwatched
attacks.description: One partner makes themselves the most interesting thing in the room — noise, spectacle, an argument worth watching — while the other moves through the space nobody is looking at. The difficulty is not the distraction; it is holding it. The loud partner has to keep going long after it stops being comfortable, because the moment they check whether their partner is clear, everyone else checks too. Waluigi held a dragon's attention with illusions while Wario and Markop took the eggs. Archie threw a chair against a wall and Bones screamed, and Luigi walked out. Daisy started a chase with Waluigi and a Charter went unsigned. The scene changes; the shape does not.
steps: The quiet partner names what they need and how long it will take, before anything starts.
The loud partner commits to something impossible to ignore and does not hedge it.
The quiet partner moves on the noise, not on a signal, and never looks back at their partner.
The loud partner keeps going until the quiet partner is clear, then finds their own way out.
attacks.risks: The loud partner is, by design, the one everybody can see, and they are the one left standing there when it ends. A distraction that is too clever gets studied instead of followed. Worst of all is looking — one glance toward the quiet partner tells the room exactly where to look next.
attacks.waluigiNote: WAH! My distraction skills have been used for something as mundane as egg heists. Truly a tragedy!

drill.promptDescription: Waluigi creates distractions to allow Wario and Markop to steal the Gold Dragon eggs.

steps.title: Shadow Illusion
steps.instruction: Tap the screen to create a shadow that momentarily blinds the dragon.

steps.title: Cover Fire
steps.instruction: Aim at the dragon to provide cover while Wario and Markop steal the eggs.

steps.title: Auditory Deception
steps.instruction: Lower your shield to cast a spell that deafens the dragon momentarily.

steps.title: Stealth Steal
steps.instruction: Run right while Wario grabs the eggs and Markop provides backup.

variations.name: Misdirection Bros Attack
variations.account: Mushroom Regency creates a distraction to mislead Chancellor Toadsworth, allowing Fawful to escape from the scene of the assassination. This act of misdirection is crucial in shifting public and political attention away from Fawful.

variations.name: Misdirection Bros Attack (Variant)
variations.account: Diddy distracts the mourners with a heartfelt eulogy, while Chunky slips away unnoticed and finds himself in a broom closet at the end of the funeral. This clever move showcases Diddy's talent for creating a diversion that allows Chunky to escape detection.

variations.name: Ghostly Misdirection Bros Attack
variations.account: Wario created a diversion, chatting with the neighbor about seemingly innocent matters, while the neighbor reconfigured his security systems to allow Wario basement access. The distraction was so effective that it even fooled Waluigi.

variations.name: Misdirection Bros Attack (Second Form)
variations.account: Archie Miser and Bones coordinated their movements to create a commotion that drew attention away from Luigi's escape. Their distraction allowed Agent L to slip past unnoticed, ensuring his continued freedom.

variations.name: Waluigi's Distraction Bros Attack
variations.account: During a tense session, Waluigi and Princess Daisy stage an impromptu game of hide-and-seek with Toadsworth Sr. to draw his attention away from the Charter signing ceremony. This allows Toadsworth Sr., who is initially reluctant but ultimately wants to sign the document, to do so without interruption.

lore.name: Gamma Discrepancy Bros Attack
lore.subtitle: Markop and Green T analyze historical data to uncover a hidden truth
lore.description: Markop and Green T examine the historical records, uncovering inconsistencies that hint at a hidden truth. Their coordination allows them to piece together fragments of information that others would miss.
lore.risks: Misinterpreting data could lead to incorrect conclusions.
lore.waluigiNote: WAH! Two pairs of glasses staring at the same screen, but seeing entirely different things. Markop's optimism and Green T's skepticism make for a fascinating duo, or so they think.
lore.prunedReason: Two people reading records together. No coordination to time, nothing to practise, and the stated risk is 'misinterpreting data'.

lore.name: Shieldwork Bros Attack Luigi Mario
lore.subtitle: Luigi stabilizes Mario for critical surgery in an emergency situation.
lore.description: Luigi, in a critical condition himself, held the surgical instruments steady while Dr. Mario operated to save his life. The coordination was crucial to prevent any missteps that could further endanger Luigi.
lore.risks: Any misalignment could lead to critical complications for Luigi.
lore.waluigiNote: WAH! So much for 'Uncle Dario' being just another alias. Looks like the Big Brother is in surgery too... or has always been.
lore.prunedReason: Luigi steadying instruments during his own surgery is a strong scene and a one-time event. It cannot be performed again by anyone.

lore.name: Feyward Book Exchange Bros Attack
lore.subtitle: Hjumpik and Waluigi read the Feyward Book of Many Things together in Sylvan
lore.description: Hjumpik and Waluigi read the Feyward Book of Many Things together, with Hjumpik ensuring that the text is correctly translated into Sylvan for Waluigi to understand. Waluigi then confirms his reading, clearing any misunderstandings.
lore.risks: Miscommunication could lead to incorrect readings or misunderstandings about the text's content.
lore.waluigiNote: WAH! We should have done this sooner. Now we're all the wiser!
lore.prunedReason: Hjumpik translating Sylvan aloud for Waluigi is a conversation, not a manoeuvre. The 'steps' are turns in a dialogue.

lore.name: Teleportation Bros Attack
lore.subtitle: Koopa and Tanukiburt teleport to unknown coordinates connecting to the Shadow Estate
lore.description: Koopa and Tanukiburt teleported together to unknown dimensional coordinates. This move was crucial as it allowed them to escape the dangerous situation in the Star Shard Caves and connect with another location.
lore.risks: If the target location is not properly scouted, the teleported characters may land in a dangerous or hostile environment.
lore.waluigiNote: WAH! Teleporting like that? Did you check if the other side is safe for landing? WAH!
lore.prunedReason: Both partners teleport. Identical action, no roles, and the drill is 'focus, go, land' for each of them separately.

lore.name: Jumping Coordination Bros Attack
lore.subtitle: Ghost and Brick simultaneously jump from the classroom window into the void
lore.description: Corporal 'Ghost' Reyes and Sergeant 'Brick' Stone, both injured but determined to survive the operation, simultaneously leap from the classroom window into the void. By jumping together, they misdirect Baldi's attention and give themselves a brief respite in the void.
lore.risks: If one partner jumps too early or late, they risk losing coordination and falling apart.
lore.waluigiNote: WAH! You think this is clever? Jumping into the void? What kind of cover are you two providing?
lore.prunedReason: Two soldiers jump out of the same window at the same time. The whole technique is the word 'simultaneously'.

lore.name: Toad Rescue Bros Attack
lore.subtitle: Mario and Luigi extract from Bowser's body
lore.description: Trapped within Bowser’s body, Mario and Luigi coordinated to navigate through the labyrinthine interior. Using their combined strength and agility, they cleared a path to freedom, evading Dark Star fragments and biological threats.
lore.risks: If one partner misjudges the timing, they risk getting separated or trapped further within Bowser’s body.
lore.waluigiNote: WAH! Mario and Luigi were busy with their 'rescue' while I was out here documenting the chaos. Classic.
lore.prunedReason: Mario and Luigi navigating out of Bowser together is travel, not a technique -- the steps are 'jump down' and 'reset for another passage', which is just walking with extra words.
